### BOTTOMK
Collects the `k` lowest values for a field, including repeated values. Shorthand for `TOP(field, k, "ASC")`, and the ES|QL aggregate analogue of PromQL `bottomk(k, v)`.

```esql
FROM employees
| STATS bottom_salaries = BOTTOMK(salary, 3)
```
